Thanks Rachel — appreciate the quick follow. We have two asks from procurement before we can host a live executive walkthrough:

1) Completed vendor questionnaire and supplier contact info
2) A signed NDA on record (procurement prefers DocuSign)

Also flag: our head of product and CFO are traveling next week (11/9–11/13) so a live slot during that window won't work for them. They pushed back and asked whether you can send a short recorded demo they can watch asynchronously — they want a 20-minute highlight of the integration flow and latency/cost expectations.

If you can provide the questionnaire and NDA link, procurement will start intake and decide on the live Q&A timing after intake completes.

Cheers,

Hi Elena — thanks for the context and the heads-up on travel. Totally understand procurement gating — we've run into this before. Two pragmatic paths we can take: 

- Option A: We record a concise 20–25 minute demo (highlighting the integration, routing policies, and a short cost/latency summary) and send it to execs this week. Follow with a 30-minute live Q&A the week after procurement completes intake.
- Option B: Hold a live demo until intake is complete. If procurement needs to see artifacts first, we can try for live dates later in November.

I've attached a redlined NDA draft and the vendor onboarding questionnaire to this thread to help procurement start the intake ASAP. If NovaConnect prefers DocuSign, we can publish the NDA there — I can send that link once you confirm.

Proposed tentative live windows (if you want to lock something now):
- Nov 17: 10:00–11:00 PT
- Nov 19: 13:00–14:00 PT

If you prefer the recorded option, I'll coordinate with Ben to film a 20-min demo and Marissa will produce a short one-pager MAP (mutual action plan) so procurement knows next steps.

Attachments: NDA_draft_Redwood_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB); vendor_questionnaire_novaconnect.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 95KB)

Hi Rachel — thanks for the attachments. Procurement confirms they will start intake once we have a DocuSign-enabled NDA and the completed questionnaire returned. Can you send the DocuSign link?

Given the exec travel next week, they'd prefer Option A (recorded demo) so they can review asynchronously. If possible, include a short transcript or time-coded bullets so they can jump to the sections they care about (latency, multi-region routing, cost controls).

Also: can you include a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) that lists expected procurement milestones (NDA signed, questionnaire reviewed, security review, pilot approval) with rough target dates? That helps our legal/procurement queue it.

Appreciate it — Luke (copied) will be our procurement owner if you need to coordinate details.

Best,
Elena
